描述_EN: bushell was a physician by profession, but his 30-year-long residence in beijing had made him a self-taught expert. bushell was a physician by profession, but his 30-year- long residence in beijing had made him a self-taught expert. the ceramics bushell selected on behalf of the museum included blue-and-white and colour-enamelled wares which were fashionable in the late 19th century. but he did not overlook the more subtle monochromes which were, a few decades later, much appreciated by collectors and connoisseurs. he made several acquisitions on behalf of the v&a and in 1898 was commissioned by the board of education to write a comprehensive book on chinese art, which has been reprinted several times. it was acquired through the good offices of dr stephen wootton bushell (1844-1908). the elegantly shaped stoneware bowl with a crackled greyish glaze was one of the v&a's early purchases of chinese art.
描述_ZN: Bushell的职业是医生，但他在北京居住了30年，使他成为自学成才的专家。 Bushell的职业是医生，但他在北京长达30年的居住使他成为一个自学成才的专家。 代表博物馆选择的陶瓷器皿包括19世纪末流行的蓝白和彩色珐琅器皿。 但他并没有忽视更微妙的单色，这些单色在几十年后受到了收藏家和鉴赏家的青睐。 他代表V&A进行了几次收购，并在1898年受教育委员会的委托写了一本关于中国艺术的综合书，该书已被多次重印。 它是通过Stephen Wootton Bushell博士（1844-1908）的斡旋获得的。 造型优雅的石器碗，带有裂纹的灰色釉面，是V&A早期购买的中国艺术品之一。
